newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Deutsche Bank extends US$50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank extends US$50 mln loan.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Wednesday it had extended a US$50 million credit facility to Asian Securitization & Infrastructure (Pte) Ltd (ASIA Ltd).
The loan would be divided into two equal tranches, a statement from Deutsche Bank said.

One is a five-year revolving credit facility to finance investment in debt issues or securitised assets guaranteed by ASIA Ltd. The other is a two-year revolving standby credit facility to finance payment of potential claims under ASIA Ltd's guarantees.
General manager Norbert Wanninger said while ASIA Ltd did not foresee claims, "the stand-by facility will nonetheless strengthen our claims paying ability".

ASIA Ltd is a financial guarantee company incorporated in Singapore. Its main shareholders include Asian Development Bank, Government of Singapore Investment Corporation, Employees Provident Fund of Malaysia, American International Assurance Co Ltd and CapMAC Asia, a subsidiary of CapMAC Holdings Inc .

ASIA Ltd is licensed and regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore. It provides financial guarantees and auxiliary services for bonds, asset-backed securities and securities issued for finance infrastructure projects in the major countries in Asia.
